variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

/-- (implementation) the braiding for R-modules -/
def braiding (M N : ModuleCat.{u} R) : M ⊗ N ≅ N ⊗ M :=
  LinearEquiv.toModuleIso (TensorProduct.comm R M N)
